etymologies.heading: Etymology
paragraphs: From either Cantonese 叩頭 / 叩头 (kau3 tau4) or Mandarin 叩頭 / 叩头 (kòutóu). Literally, “knock head”.
senses: (historical) To kneel and bow low enough to touch one’s forehead to the ground.
(figuratively) To grovel, act in a very submissive manner; to show obeisance to (someone or something) in such a manner; to bow.
